subject: Film & Cinema
title: The MacGuffin: The Thing That Doesn't Matter
description: Learn The MacGuffin: The Thing That Doesn't Matter in one minute.

hook.text: In Pulp Fiction, everyone chases a glowing briefcase. We never learn what's inside.

buildup.text: A MacGuffin is an object or goal that drives the plot but has no real importance itself.

discovery.text: Hitchcock coined the term — the MacGuffin motivates characters while the real story is elsewhere.

twist.text: The Maltese Falcon, the One Ring, and the Infinity Stones are all MacGuffins of sorts.

climax.text: The MacGuffin works because audiences care about characters, not objects.

punchline.text: The thing everyone chases never matters.

quiz.question: What is a MacGuffin in screenwriting?
options: An object that drives the plot but isn't important itself
